mentions.name: 1962 VW family-car rebuild
mentions.description: A hands-on project rebuilding the family's 1962 VW, in which the author teaches their son restoration skills and appreciates how simple older machines are to work on.
mentions.source_excerpt: In a similar vein I’m teaching my son to rebuild an old ‘62 VW that’s been in the family since ‘62 and am constantly reminded of how nice it is when things are simple.
